items.title: File Einspruch against the 2026 income tax assessment
items.quote: Der Einspruch muss innerhalb eines Monats beim Finanzamt Musterjena eingehen; die Frist beginnt mit dem Tag nach der Bekanntgabe.
items.computation: Letter is dated Mon 16 Aug 2027. Under §122 Abs.2 Nr.1 AO a letter sent by ordinary post counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting, i.e. Fri 20 Aug 2027 (posting day not later than the document date). The one-month Einspruch period (§355 AO) starts the day after delivery (§187 Abs.1 BGB / §108 Abs.1 AO), so counting begins 20 Aug 2027. One month later lands on Mon 20 Sep 2027 (§188 Abs.2 BGB). 20 Sep 2027 is Weltkindertag, a public holiday in Thüringen, so under §108 Abs.3 AO the deadline moves to the next business day, Tue 21 Sep 2027.

items.title: Receive income tax refund for 2026
items.quote: Er wird in den nächsten Tagen gutgeschrieben.
items.computation: The notice states the refund of 859,00 € will be credited 'in den nächsten Tagen' (in the next few days) after the assessment dated 16 Aug 2027, but gives no fixed calendar date, so no exact due date can be derived; this is the Finanzamt's own disbursement, not an obligation on the recipient.
